text:
Maggie G.: Quick thought 10-min mini-workshop next Thurs to walk through the new pricing calculator + quick live customer scenarios. tight, actionable, product-led.
Dario P.: sounds good. primary KPI = booked demos from attendees, secondary = calc starts on page. target demo conversion >=7%?
Maggie G.: yep, aim for 7-9%. also want to collect one use-case per registrant for SDR context.
Simeon K.: propose two page variants: (A) inline open calculator + short sign-up modal only for demo booking; (B) advanced estimator gated with email capture and firmographic fields. A/B 50/50.
Elaine R.: for gated fields, keep minimal: work email, company size, estimated monthly tokens. don't ask for phone.
Nadia L.: SDRs prefer a company size + ARR bucket. can we include a hidden field that scores lead fit? ops-bot: added rule "lead_score_calc" based on company_size + token_estimate + domain_signal
Dario P.: what's domain_signal? any domain in enterprise_allowlist => +30. otherwise neutral.
Maggie G.: landing copy idea: headline "Estimate your inference bill in 60s" subhead "Compare metered vs committed plans, see latency tradeoffs, and get a tailored recommendation." short and scannable.
Elaine R.: I'll write 3 micro-FAQ lines for each plan. Committed: "Predictable monthly bill", "Reserved capacity for steady throughput", "Priority support & SLAs". Metered: "Pay per token, scale to zero", "Burstable throughput for spikes", "Optimize cost with our batching tips".
Simeon K.: alternate FAQ language: shorter bullets for mobile: Committed: "Predictable cost", "Dedicated GPUs", "SLA"; Metered: "Usage-based", "Autoscale bursts", "Cost tips".
Dario P.: webinar/workshop flow: 1) 2m why pricing matters (benchmarks), 2) 6m walkthrough calc with two personas (start-up app + enterprise ingestion), 3) 1m decision cheatsheet, 1m CTA to book demo or try calc.
Maggie G.: benchmark narrative (Elaine pls): single-paragraph slide copy that mentions cost/latency tradeoffs and a headline stat.
Elaine R.: draft: "Across representative workloads, optimized batching + the right model choice reduced per-token spend by ~30% while preserving median P95 latency within SLO. Use the calculator to model tradeoffs for your mix of latency and throughput." will tune with numbers.
Nadia L.: registration CTA text options: "Reserve my seat" vs "Get the calculator". prefer the former for sense of urgency.
Simeon K.: tracking: UTM = pricing-miniworkshop-2733339999. add query param variant=A/B. embed script snippet for devs (lightweight iframe):
```
<iframe src="https://embed.redwood.ai/pricing-calc?utm=pricing-miniworkshop-2733339999&variant=A" width="100%" height="520" frameborder="0"></iframe>
```
Maggie G.: nice. add a tiny consent checkbox for email comms. Elaine, can you do short confirmation email copy? 1 line + CTA.
Elaine R.: confirmation: "You're registered for Pricing Mini-Workshop. Add to calendar + try the calculator now -> [Try Calculator]". will draft full sequence.
ops-bot: event created: "pricing-miniworkshop-2733339999". rule added: "tag:webinar_workshop_inbound" for registration leads. routing: if lead_score_calc >= 60 -> tag:sdrl_high_fit
Dario P.: SDR handoff: send CSV with lead_score_calc, token_estimate, company_size. Nadia, you ok with that format?
Nadia L.: yes. also add free-form use_case note from registrant.
Maggie G.: timeline: quick promo post Fri, registration live Mon, reminder day-before, live Thurs. Elaine + I will QA copy Mon morning. Simo, can you drop the iframe sample in the docs repo?
Simeon K.: will do. final success metrics: booked demos >=7% of attendees, calc starts +15% vs baseline, gated leads win-rate proxy +18%.
Elaine R.: I'll post the playbook + copy snippets in #marketing-summaries on Monday AM.
Maggie G.: perfect, thanks team :raised_hands:
